en: Improved start-up on Linux when `/home` is an autofs map: Claude Code no longer looks up files in `/home` itself. Set `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTOMOUNT_ROOTS` for a map root deeper than one folder below `/`
zh: 改进了 Linux 上 `/home` 为 autofs 映射时的启动：Claude Code 不再在 `/home` 本身中查找文件。对于位于 `/` 下一层以上目录的映射根，请设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTOMOUNT_ROOTS`
